issue.title: Remove the dead clan cleanup scope from the Rust cleanup planner and its Python mirror
issue.description:
While planning the removal of the "Choose clan" option from the ACE Agent Cleanup panel (which deletes the only producers of the `clan` cleanup scope: `AgentCleanupClanModal` and `AgentCleanupClanMixin._plan_clan_cleanup_container`), I confirmed the scope will become dead wire surface with no remaining producer:

- sase-core (`crates/sase_core/src/agent_cleanup/`): `CLEANUP_SCOPE_CLAN` in `wire.rs:16`, request fields `clan_name`/`clan_generation` (`wire.rs:119-121`), target fields `agent_clan`/`agent_clan_generation` (`wire.rs:83-85`, used only by the clan-scope match), the `CLEANUP_SCOPE_CLAN` planner arm (`planner.rs:95-103`), and the clan-scope planner tests (~lines 1209-1330, 1600+, 2012).
- sase repo Python mirror: `CLEANUP_SCOPE_CLAN`, `clan_name`/`clan_generation`, and `agent_clan`/`agent_clan_generation` in `src/sase/core/agent_cleanup_wire.py`, the clan-scope branch in `src/sase/core/agent_cleanup_python.py:90-96`, the clan target fields copied in `src/sase/core/agent_cleanup_targets.py:51-52`, and the clan tests under `tests/test_core_facade/`.

Removing the scope requires the Rust wire change, an `AGENT_CLEANUP_WIRE_SCHEMA_VERSION` bump decision (the Python facade falls back to the reference planner on version mismatch), a sase-core release/floor bump, and a lockstep mirror update in the sase repo — cross-repo work that should not ride along with the TUI-only option removal.

Precondition: do not start until the "Choose clan" panel-option removal tale has landed (it deletes the last producers of this scope).

task_type_fields.proposal: Delete the clan cleanup scope end-to-end once nothing produces it: CLEANUP_SCOPE_CLAN, clan_name/clan_generation request fields, agent_clan/agent_clan_generation target fields, the planner clan arm and its tests in sase-core, plus the mirrored constants/branch/fields/tests in the sase repo, with the wire schema version handled so the facade's Rust/Python planners stay in agreement.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The current work is a sase-repo-only TUI change (remove the Choose clan option and its chooser modal/mixin). Deleting the planner scope crosses the Rust core boundary and needs a sase-core wire change, schema-version bump, release/floor coordination, and a lockstep Python-mirror update, so it must land separately after the TUI removal.
